name: Masked Confessions
source:
You entered the room with questions. You'll leave with a mask in your hands... and your heart in his.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你怀揣满腹疑问踏入这间房；而当你离开时，手中握着的将是一副面具……你的心则已落入他的掌心。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
